comment: The worst business class I ever took. Do not take him if you want to be a finance concentration because you won't be prepared at all for the next levels. The classes were short but he was unhelpful and extremely vague. If you want to learn or get a good grade, take someone else.
Always lets you out early but he doesn't teach at all during class. You have to teach yourself everything for tests. Lets you take a sheet of paper with you for the test.
